identified_threats.impact: tests or receipts can reflect developer-only bytes
identified_threats.required_control: fresh clean candidate checkout distinct from development checkout

identified_threats.impact: commit, tree, config, data, model, rule or provider can differ across components
identified_threats.required_control: exact hashes in every component and fail-closed cross-component comparison

identified_threats.impact: a summary PASS can replace required raw verification
identified_threats.required_control: typed component receipts rebuilt from raw external artifacts by fixed verifiers

identified_threats.impact: local candidate can differ from the pushed subject
identified_threats.required_control: two remote subject/tree readbacks around final aggregation

identified_threats.impact: credentials, raw source, blind truth or internal identifiers can enter Git, logs, API or DOM
identified_threats.required_control: repository allowlist plus log, public JSON and DOM scans with zero tolerance

identified_threats.impact: agent or fixture evidence can be presented as human, public, production or commercial proof
identified_threats.required_control: explicit NOT_RUN boundaries in RunSpec, manifest and final receipt

alternative_controls: fresh clean checkout with no authority secret mounts
strict typed component receipts and deterministic revalidation
remote branch subject/tree readback before and after aggregation
privacy, secret, log, public JSON and DOM zero-hit scans
H1, public network, production, commercial, release, deployment and main remain NOT_RUN or NOT_REQUESTED
decision_rationale: The current claim is a local agent-verified candidate, not organizational independence or production assurance. The identified threats are covered by clean-checkout isolation, exact hash binding, strict revalidation, privacy scans and remote readback. Optional legacy controls would add custody complexity without closing the remaining human, organizational or production gaps.
residual_risks: the same repository organization and account still control source, branch and CI
host or GitHub compromise is not independently attested
no public network, production SLO, commercial or release evidence exists
